homepage.title: $t(name)
homepage.subtitle: A collection of various assets for use within Beat Saber.

assets.nsfwWarning: This asset is marked as NSFW.

upload.createAssetSubtitle: Please fill out the form below to upload a new asset to ModelSaber.
upload.thumbnailRuleList1: Must be a square image (1:1 aspect ratio).
upload.thumbnailFooter: Please ensure your thumbnail follows the rules listed above.
upload.ensureRights: Please ensure that you have the rights to upload this asset to ModelSaber.

preview.noAudioSupport: Your browser does not support the audio element.
preview.noPreviewAvailable: No preview available for this asset.
preview.textOnlySr: This preview only shows the content within the file. If you wish to read it, please download the file and open it with your system.

verified.title: This asset has been verified by the ModelSaber team and is safe to use!
verified.description: Verified assets have been checked for malware and are safe to use. Look for the green checkmark!

unverified.title: This asset has not been verified by the ModelSaber team. Use at your own risk!
unverified.description: Unverified assets have not been checked for malware. Be cautious when downloading and using these assets.

queue.title: This asset is currently pending approval. Use with caution!
queue.description: Assets in the queue have not been reviewed by the approval team. They may contain malware or be incompatible with the game. Be cautious when downloading and using these assets. You will not receive support for unverified assets.

private.title: This asset is private.
private.description: Private assets are not visible to the public

removed.title: This asset has been removed.
removed.description: Removed assets have been taken down by the approval team and are not visible to the public.

mods.nameIdExplanation: The Manifest ID is a unique identifier for this project that is used in the manifest (e.g. the "id" field in a BSIPA manifest) of all of your versions. It is typically the same as the name. This cannot be changed after the project is created.
mods.deprecatedVersionWarning: Your selected game version is no longer supported.
mods.deprecatedVersionWarningDescription: This version is no longer community supported and may not receive mod updates. Please consider updating your game to a more recent or supported version.

createProject.title: Create Project
createProject.subtitle: Please fill out the form below to create a new project.
createProject.thumbnailRuleList1: Must be a square image (1:1 aspect ratio).
createProject.thumbnailFooter: Please ensure your icon follows the rules listed above.

createVersion.title: Create Version for {{projectName}}
createVersion.subtitle: Please fill out the form below to create a new version for {{projectName}}.
createVersion.semverShouldMatchManifest: The semantic version should match the version specified in your manifest.json file.
createVersion.importFromOtherVersionDialogDescription: Select another version of {{projectName}} to import dependencies from. This will copy all dependencies from the selected version to the new version you are creating.
createVersion.packingFileIntoZip: Your DLL file will be packed into a zip file upon upload in the Plugins folder. If you want to include additional files, or if your DLL should be placed in a different folder, please create a zip file with the correct structure and upload that instead.

manifestChecks.couldNotReadManifest: Could not read manifest from file. Please ensure it is a valid .dll or .zip file containing a manifest.json.
manifestChecks.manifestProjectNameMismatch: The name specified in your manifest ({{manifestName}}) doesn't match the name of the project you're uploading to ({{expectedName}}). Please ensure the 'name' field in your manifest matches the name of your project on ModelSaber.
manifestChecks.manifestProjectIdMismatch: The manifest ID specified in your manifest ({{manifestId}}) doesn't match the manifest ID of the project you're uploading to ({{expectedManifestId}}). Please ensure the 'id' field in your manifest matches the manifest ID of your project on ModelSaber.

dependencies.manifestMissingdependsOn: Your manifest is missing the 'dependsOn' field, which is required to specify your mod's dependencies. Please add this field to your manifest and try again.
dependencies.webInvalidRange: Dependency {{depName}} has an invalid game version range specified: {{sv}}. Please ensure all dependencies have valid semantic version ranges.
dependencies.manifestInvalidRange: Dependency {{depName}} has an invalid game version range specified: {{sv}}. Please ensure all dependencies in your manifest have valid semantic version ranges.
dependencies.webDependencyNotFound: Dependency {{depName}}@{{sv}} was not found in the manifest. Please ensure all dependencies listed are included in the manifest file.
dependencies.manifestDependencyNotFound: Dependency {{depName}}@{{sv}} specified in manifest not found. Please ensure all dependencies listed in your manifest are marked as dependencies on ModelSaber.

manifestChecks.manifestGameVersionIsntLowest: The game version specified in your manifest ({{manifestGameVersion}}) isn't the lowest game version specified among your supported game versions. Please ensure the 'gameVersion' field in your manifest specifies the lowest game version your mod supports, or update your supported game versions to match the game version specified in your manifest.
manifestChecks.manifestSemVerDoesntMatch: The semantic version specified in your manifest ({{manifestSemVer}}) doesn't match the semantic version specified for your mod ({{expectedSemVer}}). Please ensure the 'semver' field in your manifest matches the version of your mod.
manifestChecks.duplicateDependency: The dependency {{depName}} appears more than once. Please ensure each dependency is listed only once.

verified.title: This mod has been verified by the approval team and is safe to use!
verified.description: Verified mods are safe and should not cause issues the game. Look for the green badge!

unverified.title: This mod has not been verified by the approval team. Use at your own risk!
unverified.description: Unverified mods have not been fully checked for issues and compatibility. While they may be fine, be cautious when downloading and using these mods. You will not receive support for non-verified mods.

testing.title: This mod is currently pending approval.
testing.description: Mods in the testing phase have been reviewed by the approval team and are currently in testing. It may be incompatible with the game or cause other issues. Be cautious when downloading and using these mods. These mods are not fully verified and you will not receive support for them. That being said, please let the approval team know about any issues you experience using these mods.

queue.title: This mod is currently pending approval. Use with caution!
queue.description: Mods in the queue have not been fully reviewed by the approval team. They may cause issues or be incompatible with the game. Be cautious when downloading and using these mods. You will not receive support for non-verified mods.

private.title: This mod is private.
private.description: Private mods are not visible to the public.

removed.title: This mod has been removed.
removed.description: Removed mods have been taken down by the approval team and are not visible to the public.

requests.wouldYouLikeToAcceptOrReject: Would you like to accept or reject this request?
requests.initialMessageCredit: {{name}} would like to add you as a collaborator to the asset {{assetName}}.
requests.initialMessageLink: {{name}} would like to link your asset, {{toLinkAssetName}}, to their asset, {{assetName}}.
requests.noMessagesFound: No messages found for this request.

approvalDialog.title: Update Status for {{name}}
approvalDialog.description: Select the new status for "{{name}}". Click save to apply the changes.
approvalDialog.reasonWillBeVisible: This reason will be visible to the author(s) of {{name}}.

downloadDialog.assetDescription: The asset you are trying to download has not been verified by the approval team. Unverified assets may cause issues or contain other harmful content. Are you sure you want to proceed with the download?
downloadDialog.nonVerifiedModDescription: The mod you are trying to download has not been fully verified by the approval team. Non-verified mods may be incompatible with the game or cause other issues. You will not receive support in BSMG for unverified mods. Are you sure you want to proceed with the download?
downloadDialog.testingModDescription: The mod you are trying to download is currently in testing and is awaiting full verification. Non-verified mods may be incompatible with the game or cause other issues. These mods are not fully verified and you will not receive support for them. That being said, please let the approval team know about any issues you experience using these mods. Are you sure you want to proceed with the download?
downloadDialog.neverShowAgain: If you'd like to never see this warning again, please click the "Don't show again" button.

reportDialog.title: Report {{name}}
reportDialog.description: If you believe this item violates our rules, please provide a reason for reporting it. Our moderation team will review the report and take appropriate action if necessary.

linkAssetDialog.title: Add a Related Asset
linkAssetDialog.description: Link another asset as related to this one by entering the link to the asset's page below.

altFormat.title: Alternative Format
altFormat.description: Same asset in a different file format (e.g. a saber in the .saber and .whacker formats)

altDesign.title: Alternative Design
altDesign.description: A different design or version of the same asset (e.g. a saber with a different color scheme or model)

newerVersion.title: Newer Version
newerVersion.description: A more recent version of the asset, typically with improvements or updates

olderVersion.title: Older Version
olderVersion.description: A previous version of the asset released before the current one

error.generic: An error occurred. Please try again later.

validation.missingFields: Please fill out all required fields.
validation.invalidFile: The selected file is invalid. Please select a valid file.

secretFeatures.unlockedDescription: If you enable these features, you will be able to access hidden content and features on ModelSaber. ModelSaber is not responsible for any damage caused by this content. You will not receive support for any issues caused by this content.
secretFeatures.enabledDescription: You can now access hidden content and features on ModelSaber. Use responsibly!
secretFeatures.mustBeLoggedIn: You must be logged in to activate this feature.
secretFeatures.alreadyEnabled: You have already activated the secret features.
secretFeatures.alreadyEnabledDescription: If you want to disable them, disable them in your user settings.
secretFeatures.disabledDescription: Access to hidden content and features has been revoked.
